title: Create, edit, and delete one-time and recurring events

confirmed_time_zone_policy.origin: phone zone at creation, retained by timed event
confirmed_time_zone_policy.recurrence: same local clock time in origin zone across normal DST changes

special_DST_times.gap: shift by actual gap duration; requested recurrence clock unchanged on normal dates

confirmed_event_fields.title: required
confirmed_event_fields.timed_semantics: date and local start time with automatic 1-hour duration

monthly_fallback_details.numbered_day: last calendar day when requested number is absent
monthly_fallback_details.ordinal_weekday: last matching weekday when requested ordinal is absent

confirmed_recurrence.first_occurrence: first matching occurrence on or after chosen lower-bound date

form_defaults.title: empty
form_defaults.date: Day displayed date; Month/Week today in displayed period, otherwise first date of that month/week

confirmed_creation.save_cancel_navigation: Save returns to originating view on saved occurrence; cancel/back discards uncommitted changes and restores original period

coder_blockers: Complete written EVENTS specification is ready_for_review and requires explicit owner approval before implementation.

proposed_remaining_decisions.D1: Default one-time/all-day + form, contextual date, explicit chosen hour, return to originating view; cancel commits nothing
proposed_remaining_decisions.D2: Gap shifts by gap duration, overlap uses earlier instant; original zone shown for editing; 60 elapsed minutes
proposed_remaining_decisions.D3: Text changes preserve individual overrides; temporal/mode/recurrence changes reset affected overrides and cancellations only with explicit warning/confirmation
proposed_remaining_decisions.D4: Allow automatic one-hour midnight crossing without multi-day range input; one logical occurrence

confirmed_series_edit_policy.text: Preserve locally overridden fields; other fields inherit changed series values
confirmed_series_edit_policy.temporal_mode_or_recurrence: Reset affected overrides/cancellations only after explicit warning and confirmation; may restore deleted occurrences

specification_approval.decisions: D1-D4 approved; complete written criteria/features/QA now await explicit approval before coding

implementation_notes: Reuse parse-gherkin and extend the existing CAL-only generator/Gradle/runtime adapter; do not create a parallel parser/runner.
Coordinate app-private durable storage with PERSISTENCE-001; no storage technology or in-memory-only product decision is made by this specification.
